fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Motorized platoons provide the speed the FWLM needs to cover the vast distances between garrison posts on provincial worlds, mounting troops on light vehicles that can respond to threats faster than foot infantry but without the expense of full mechanization. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers, these platoons pack anti-armor punch that standard rifle or laser formations cannot match, capable of threatening light vehicles and even damaging BattleMech leg actuators at close range.
